headline: Executive order closed federal executive departments and agencies on Monday, December 24, 2012, Christmas Eve.
what_it_does: This order closed the executive departments and agencies of the federal government for one day, Monday, December 24, 2012. That day fell between a weekend and the Christmas holiday. The title does not give details on exceptions or how employees were treated, so those specifics are not covered here.

who_it_affects.how: Their offices were closed on December 24, 2012, so most were not expected to report to work that day.

who_it_affects.group: People who use federal agency offices
who_it_affects.how: Agency offices were closed to the public that day, so in-person services were generally unavailable.
